author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಜನುಮ ನಿನಗೇನೆ ತಿಳಿದಿಲ್ಲ
ಏನಾಗಲಿದೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಅರಿವಿಲ್ಲ ನಿನಗೆ
ಏನಾಗಿ ನೀನಿಹೆಯೊ ಅದನೀನು ಚೆನ್ನಗಿಡೆ
ನಿನಬದುಕು ಹಸನೆಂದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: You yourself do not know your previous birth;
you have no idea what is to come;
if you keep well what you are now,
your life will be good, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We know nothing of our past births and nothing of what lies ahead. All we can tend is who we are today; take care of that, and life turns out well.
